xptracker.config.title: XPTracker Settings
xptracker.config.persist_sessions.desc: Save session data to disk so it persists across world leaves
xptracker.config.show_session_summary.de: Show a summary in chat when resetting a session
xptracker.config.hud_enabled.desc: Show the XP tracker overlay on screen
xptracker.config.hud_position.desc: Corner of the screen where the HUD is displayed
xptracker.config.hud_scale.desc: Scale of the HUD text and background (50% - 200%)
xptracker.config.show_background.desc: Draw a dark background behind the HUD text
xptracker.config.show_level_gains.desc: Show gained levels alongside or instead of XP points
xptracker.config.show_xp_sources.desc: Show a breakdown of where XP came from (Combat, Mining, Smelting, etc.)
xptracker.chat.restored: Previous XP session restored! Press [%s] to continue
